hints.title: Adjacent Plus Pair Detection
hints.text: Identify all occurrences of two consecutive plus signs in the current state string.

hints.title: Sub-String Replacement Generation
hints.text: For each index where s[i] and s[i+1] are plus signs, form a new string by replacing that pair with two minus signs.

hints.title: Single Pass String Slice Collection
hints.text: Iterate index i from zero to length minus two. If the slice of length two equals plus plus, construct prefix plus minus minus plus suffix, and append to result list.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N^2) time and O(N^2) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: There are at most N possible moves, and creating each next state string requires O(N) copy operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Scanning linearly and slicing on match is optimal and unavoidable due to string immutability.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle boundary cases such as strings with length less than 2 cleanly.
